posts.description: I finally upgraded my mail server to Debian 13 and, as expected, the Dovecot part was quite a ride. posts.title: Home Assistant, Govee Lights Local, VLANs, Oh my!
posts.description: We recently bought some Govee Glide Hexa Light Panels , because they have a local LAN API that is well integrated into Home Assistant . Or so we thought.
